The IDF identified them as Ahmad Badran Nimer Sawafiri, a company commander in the group's engineering unit, Mustafa Yousef Mustafa Rifai and Khaled Od Fathi Na'im.

The military said they were conducting reconnaissance between positions controlled by various armed groups at the time of the strike. It also alleged that one of the men had previously worked for an international humanitarian organization but was dismissed after the IDF provided information about his alleged militant activity.
